summary: @ornikar/babel-preset-react preinstall executes obfuscated bundle via downloaded Bun runtime
details: The package declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs` in package.json. setup.mjs is an obfuscator.io-style script (`_0xNNNN` identifier renaming, mangled property dictionaries) that downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<ver>/... and then uses `execFileSync(bunPath, [math_init.js])` to run a ~727KB sibling file, math_init.js, that ships in the tarball. math_init.js begins with a `// @bun @bun-cjs` header and is heavily obfuscated (string-array rotation, `_0xNNNN` names, math-themed identifiers such as `MmgoCP`, `WV8StW`). The package's declared purpose is a thin Babel preset wrapper (index.js is roughly ten lines) and has no need for an alternate language runtime or an opaque compiled bundle. On `npm install`, the preinstall hook fires automatically, fetches a second runtime, and executes the obfuscated payload on the installer's host under Bun to evade Node-based scanners.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
